# AYLA - Esprit d'Elegance

> Premium minimalist fine jewelry born in Casablanca, Morocco. Three curated collections (Luna, Sahara, Noor), crafted with intention for the modern woman. Prices in Moroccan dirham (MAD).

AYLA (aylamaison.com) is a fine jewelry maison from Casablanca. The catalogue spans three collections and nine pieces in 18K gold vermeil and precious materials.

## Collections
- Luna Collection: inspired by moonlit Casablanca nights
- Sahara Collection: born from the warmth of desert gold
- Noor Collection: light that adorns, not overwhelms

## Pages
- [Shop](https://aylamaison.com/shop.html): full catalogue with prices and materials
- [About](https://aylamaison.com/about.html): the maison's story
- [Contact](https://aylamaison.com/contact.html): get in touch
